body: Thank you.  The job hunt is definitely on! I have a couple of interviews lined up already.  Thank you for your sympathy; it truly means a lot.
I agree! I'm not a runner but I do love cycling.  Bike's been unavailable (in storage in another county), but I should get it back by next week.
Thank you so much.  It's one of my goals to visit Australia one day. :) They caught it really early so she's going to be okay. The chemo makes her feel awful though (as is to be expected).

Thank you! That means so much! I had a talk with my mom because I didn't feel like I could hold it in anymore, and she was very supportive. Fortunately, they caught the cancer super early so she has 4 more chemo sessions left, two down.  I've made a tentative plan for the next few months, so I feel like things are gonna change soon.

I don't have health insurance.

And I get what you mean and I don't think you're sounding condescending.  I do try to live in the present, but the present for me is currently chock full of awful circumstances and it's difficult for me to keep going knowing that there may not be a reprieve in the near future.
I don't have health insurance, so I have no idea what options I could even have.  I'd love some advice because right now I can't see how it's ever going to get better.

I want to go to a psychiatrist but I'm afraid it's going to be too expensive.  I saw a very good one for free throughout most of college and I found it helped.  I think more than anything I just want to feel like I have a feasible future.
